title: Pushout of a fixed-object coproduct after replacing one factor
statement: Let $O$ be a small set and let $F,A,V$ be small ordinary categories [def-nagata-category] with object set $O$. All functors fix $O$. Write $F*_O A$ and $F*_O V$ for coproducts in the category of small categories with object set $O$ and functors equal to the identity on $O$, and let $v:A\to V$ be a functor. Form the pushout $P=(F*_O A)\amalg_A V$ of the coproduct inclusion $A\to F*_O A$ and $v$ in that fixed-object category. Write $a:F*_O A\to P$ and $b:V\to P$ for the pushout structure functors. The canonical functor $F*_O V\to P$, induced by the composite $F\to F*_O A\xrightarrow{a}P$ and by $b$, is an isomorphism. Under this isomorphism the pushout structure map from $F*_O A$ restricts to the inclusion of $F$ and sends the $A$ factor through $v$ into $V$; equivalently, functors from $P$ to any fixed-object category are exactly pairs of functors from $F$ and $V$ agreeing on $O$.
